headline: Alonso will race the 2027 Dakar Rally for Aston Martin
body: Fernando Alonso enters Aston Martin's first Dakar Rally in January, seven years after his one previous start, when he finished 13th with Toyota. Marc Coma is again his co-driver, in one of three Prodrive-run Aston Martin Dreadnoughts. Alonso has extended his Formula 1 deal with the team for 2027.

headline: FIA president says the next engine formula is agreed
body: Mohammed Ben Sulayem has indicated the FIA has agreed the replacement for the 2026 power unit formula, posting "V8s coming soon" on social media. The FIA is aiming to introduce it as early as 2030.
